title: The Sweet Kitchen
author: Ansel Sandoval
blurb: Gideon Zhou, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
